paragraphs.en: Recent text- and image-conditioned 3D generative models can synthesize high-quality textured assets across increasingly diverse object categories [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . These advances dramatically lower the barrier from a visual idea or reference to an initial 3D candidate asset, with applications in games, immersive media, and digital content creation [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . Although the quality of assets generated from a single image or text prompt continues to improve, integrating such generators into artistic workflows requires more interactive and controllable guidance mechanisms [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期基于文本和图像条件的三维生成模型，能够合成跨日益多样化的物体类别的高质量纹理资产 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 这些进步显著降低了从视觉创意或参考素材到生成初步三维候选资产的门槛，并应用于游戏、沉浸式媒体和数字内容创作等领域 [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] 。 尽管通过单张图像或文本提示生成的资产质量持续提升，但要将此类生成器整合到艺术工作流程中，还需要更具互动性和可控性的引导机制 [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In practice, asset creation is iterative [ 18 , 19 ] and part-specific [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , rather than one-shot: creators establish coarse structure, inspect generated candidates, retain some design decisions, and revise others [ 25 ] . Some parts may have to follow an intended shape, whereas others are left under-constrained, relying on the generative prior [ 26 ] . Supporting this process requires control not only over what is generated, but also over where each instruction applies and how strictly it should be followed [ 20 , 27 , 28 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，资产创建是一个迭代的过程 [ 18 , 19 ]，并且具有局部性特征 [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ]，而非一次性完成：创作者会先建立粗略的结构，检查生成的候选方案，保留部分设计决策，并修改其他部分 [ 25 ]。 某些部分可能需要遵循预期的形状，而另一些部分则可能约束不足，依赖生成模型的先验知识 [ 26 ]。 要支持这一过程，不仅需要控制生成的内容，还需要控制每条指令适用的位置以及应遵循的严格程度 [ 20 , 27 , 28 ]。

paragraphs.en: To support this need, recent methods augment general-purpose 3D generators [ 29 , 3 ] with controllable geometric or appearance guidance [ 28 , 30 ] . On one hand, proxy-guided approaches [ 28 , 31 ] enable geometric conditioning by guiding 3D generation with an input 3D shape. However, they apply this conditioning globally , such that all regions are equally constrained by the input geometry. On the other hand, other approaches introduce test-time, part-aware guidance for appearance transfer [ 30 ] or localized editing of implicit representations [ 32 ] , while leaving geometry generation unconstrained or operating post-hoc on pre-existing representations. Appearance guidance is also limited to a single global condition, preventing different cues from being assigned to different regions. Existing approaches therefore lack a unified mechanism for local control over both geometry and appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 为满足这一需求，近期方法通过可控的几何或外观引导 [28, 30] 来增强通用 3D 生成器 [29, 3]。 一方面，代理引导方法 [28, 31] 通过输入 3D 形状指导 3D 生成，从而实现几何条件约束。 然而，这些方法以全局方式应用这种条件约束，导致所有区域都受到输入几何形状的同等限制。 另一方面，其他方法在测试阶段引入了基于部件的外观转移引导 [30] 或隐式表示的局部编辑 [32]，但几何生成过程本身不受约束，或仅对已有表示进行事后处理。 外观引导也仅限于单一的全局条件，无法将不同提示分配给不同区域。 因此，现有方法缺乏对几何和外观同时进行局部控制的统一机制。

paragraphs.en: We propose SpaceFlow , a unified approach for local control of both geometry and appearance during 3D generation, as shown in Fig. 1 . In practice, the user specifies the geometry and scene layout as an explicit geometric input, decomposed into an arbitrary set of local parts that can be addressed independently. For geometric conditioning, we assign a local control level to each part: higher levels enforce closer adherence to the specified geometry, whereas lower levels leave more freedom to the generative prior. The formulation is agnostic to how individual parts are represented, ranging from coarse geometric primitives to detailed meshes. Following [ 28 ] , we represent parts as superquadric primitives [ 33 ] , which provide a compact, expressive, and easily editable representation. These can either be defined manually or initialized from existing geometry using shape decomposition methods [ 34 , 35 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpaceFlow，这是一种在 3D 生成过程中对几何形状和外观进行局部控制的统一方法，如图 1 所示。 在实际应用中，用户将几何形状和场景布局作为显式的几何输入指定，并将其分解为任意一组可独立处理的局部部分。 对于几何条件约束，我们为每个部分分配一个局部控制级别：较高的级别要求更紧密地遵循指定的几何形状，而较低的级别则留给生成先验更多自由度。 该公式不依赖于各个部分的表示方式，从粗略的几何基本体到精细的网格均可适用。 遵循 [28] 的方法，我们将各部分表示为超二次曲面基本体 [33]，这种表示方式既紧凑、富有表现力，又易于编辑。 这些基本体既可以手动定义，也可以通过形状分解方法 [34, 35] 从现有几何形状中初始化。

paragraphs.en: We use the same part decomposition for appearance conditioning. Specifically, the user can assign a distinct appearance condition to each part, allowing different regions to be controlled independently. We achieve this by restricting cross-attention to the condition associated with each part, while retaining global self-attention across all tokens. This enables distinct local appearances while preserving coherence and smooth blending across the generated asset.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对外观条件也采用相同的部件分解方法。 具体来说，用户可以为每个部件指定一个独立的外观条件，从而实现不同区域的独立控制。 我们通过将交叉注意力限制在每个部件对应的外观条件上，同时保留所有标记之间的全局自注意力来实现这一点。 这样既能实现各自独立的局部外观，又能保持生成资产的整体连贯性和平滑过渡。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the geometric and appearance components separately and demonstrate their combined capabilities on diverse multipart assets. Regional geometry metrics show that SpaceFlow preserves strongly constrained regions more faithfully than weak global conditioning, while allowing greater variation in weakly constrained regions than strong global conditioning. A user study further supports this balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom. On fixed geometry, our VLM-as-a-judge evaluation of localized text-conditioned appearance shows higher prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy than the evaluated TRELLIS and GuideFlow3D variants [ 3 , 30 ] . We additionally demonstrate localized image-conditioned appearance through qualitative results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别评估几何和外观组件，并在多种多部件资产上展示了它们的综合能力。 区域几何指标表明，SpaceFlow 比弱全局条件约束能更忠实地保留强约束区域，同时比强全局条件约束允许弱约束区域有更大的变化空间。 一项用户研究进一步支持了这种在几何保真度与生成自由度之间的平衡。 在固定几何结构上，我们使用 VLM 作为评判者的局部文本条件外观评估显示，其提示忠实度和颜色/材质准确性高于所评估的 TRELLIS 和 GuideFlow3D 变体 [3, 30]。 我们还通过定性结果展示了局部图像条件的外观效果。

paragraphs.en: 3D Asset Generation. Generative 3D modeling has advanced rapidly in output fidelity and representation flexibility, from explicit point clouds [ 36 ] and implicit functions [ 7 ] to compact latent-space approaches [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . Recently, large-scale generators have achieved strong fidelity: CLAY [ 1 ] leverages multi-resolution latent spaces, Hunyuan3D [ 2 ] scales diffusion for high-resolution textured assets, SAM 3D [ 29 ] enables single-image 3D reconstruction, and TRELLIS [ 3 ] introduces structured latents factoring geometry and appearance on a sparse voxel grid. However, these models condition on a global text or image prompt and lack fine-grained, localized part control.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 资产生成。 生成式 3D 建模在输出保真度和表示灵活性方面取得了快速进步，从显式的点云 [ 36 ] 和隐式函数 [ 7 ]，到紧凑的潜在空间方法 [ 37 , 38 , 39 ]。 最近，大规模生成器已实现了高保真度：CLAY [ 1 ] 利用多分辨率潜在空间，Hunyuan3D [ 2 ] 扩展了扩散模型以生成高分辨率纹理资产，SAM 3D [ 29 ] 实现了单图像 3D 重建，而 TRELLIS [ 3 ] 则引入了结构化潜在变量，在稀疏体素网格上对几何形状和外观进行分解。 然而，这些模型依赖于全局文本或图像提示，缺乏精细的局部部件控制能力。

paragraphs.en: Spatially Controllable 3D Generation. Spatially controllable generation conditions on explicit 3D inputs, such as voxels, primitives, proxy shapes, or meshes, rather than ambiguous text or images [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 28 ] . Existing frameworks either fine-tune generative models to accept structural conditions [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] at additional training cost, or enforce test-time constraints via optimization and latent projection [ 40 , 28 ] without retraining. Closest to our structural setting, SpaceControl [ 28 ] injects user-specified geometry into a pretrained generator’s latent space with a control strength that trades geometric fidelity for generative realism. However, since this trade-off is applied uniformly across the entire asset, it cannot handle scenarios where designated regions must strictly preserve input geometry while others are left unconstrained for generative completion [ 28 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 空间可控的三维生成。 在显式三维输入（如体素、基本几何体、代理形状或网格）上实现空间可控的生成，而非依赖模糊的文本或图像 [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 28 ] 。 现有框架要么通过额外训练成本微调生成模型以接受结构条件 [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] ，要么在测试阶段通过优化和潜在空间投影施加约束 [ 40 , 28 ] ，而无需重新训练。 与我们的结构化设定最接近的是 SpaceControl [ 28 ]，它将用户指定的几何结构注入预训练生成器的潜在空间中，并通过控制强度在几何保真度与生成真实感之间进行权衡。 然而，由于这种权衡在整个资产上被统一应用，因此无法处理需要特定区域严格保留输入几何结构，而其他区域则保持无约束以供生成性补全的场景 [ 28 ] 。

sents.zh: 现有框架要么通过额外训练成本微调生成模型以接受结构条件 [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] ，要么在测试阶段通过优化和潜在空间投影施加约束 [ 40 , 28 ] ，而无需重新训练。

sents.en: Closest to our structural setting, SpaceControl [ 28 ] injects user-specified geometry into a pretrained generator’s latent space with a control strength that trades geometric fidelity for generative realism.
sents.zh: 与我们的结构化设定最接近的是 SpaceControl [ 28 ]，它将用户指定的几何结构注入预训练生成器的潜在空间中，并通过控制强度在几何保真度与生成真实感之间进行权衡。

sents.en: However, since this trade-off is applied uniformly across the entire asset, it cannot handle scenarios where designated regions must strictly preserve input geometry while others are left unconstrained for generative completion [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: 然而，由于这种权衡在整个资产上被统一应用，因此无法处理需要特定区域严格保留输入几何结构，而其他区域则保持无约束以供生成性补全的场景 [ 28 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Appearance Control for 3D Assets. Appearance control has been widely explored across mesh texturing [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] , radiance fields, and 3D Gaussian splats [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] . These methods primarily formulate appearance control as post-hoc texturing or stylization of an existing 3D asset, whereas our focus is localized appearance conditioning during the generative flow process [ 43 , 44 , 48 , 49 ] . GuideFlow3D [ 30 ] provided training-free guidance of a pretrained rectified-flow model using a self-similarity loss for robust appearance transfer. However, it transfers a single appearance source globally across the generated asset. In contrast, SpaceFlow routes independent visual conditions to specific semantic parts, eliminating cross-part leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 资产的表面外观控制。 表面外观控制在网格纹理化 [43, 44, 45, 46, 47]、辐射场以及 3D 高斯斑点 [48, 49, 50] 等领域得到了广泛研究。 这些方法主要将表面外观控制表述为对现有 3D 资产的后续纹理化或风格化处理，而我们的研究重点则是在生成流过程中实现局部化的外观条件约束 [43, 44, 48, 49]。 GuideFlow3D [30] 利用自相似性损失，无需训练即可对预训练的修正流模型进行引导，从而实现稳健的表面外观迁移。 然而，该方法会将单一的外观源全局地迁移到整个生成的资产上。 相比之下，SpaceFlow 将独立的视觉条件路由到特定的语义部分，从而避免了不同部分之间的外观泄漏。

paragraphs.en: Part-Aware Generation and Editing. A complementary line of work introduces part-aware generators, which incorporate explicit part structure through hierarchical graphs and programs [ 21 , 24 ] , implicit or radiance-field representations, and diffusion over point or latent spaces [ 22 , 51 , 23 , 26 ] , including recent part-level reconstruction and synthesis methods [ 20 , 42 , 52 , 53 , 54 ] . In contrast, SpaceFlow does not require the generated asset to be represented as parts; it uses primitives and part assignments only as localized control signals for a pretrained generator.
paragraphs.zh: 感知部件的生成与编辑。 另一条互补的研究路线引入了感知部件的生成器，这些生成器通过层次化图和程序 [ 21 , 24 ]、隐式或辐射场表示，以及对点空间或潜在空间的扩散 [ 22 , 51 , 23 , 26 ] 来整合显式的部件结构，其中包括近期的部件级重建与合成方法 [ 20 , 42 , 52 , 53 , 54 ]。 相比之下，SpaceFlow 不要求生成的资产以部件形式表示；它仅将原语和部件分配用作预训练生成器的局部控制信号。

paragraphs.en: TRELLIS [ 3 ] is a pretrained 3D generator based on structured latents (SLAT), which attach local feature vectors to the active voxels of a sparse 3D grid. It generates assets in two stages using rectified flow transformers: first establishing the coarse sparse voxel structure, and then synthesizing the local geometry and appearance latents on the active voxels. Finally, different decoders are applied to map SLAT to diverse 3D representations [ 56 , 57 , 58 ] of high quality.
paragraphs.zh: TRELLIS [ 3 ] 是一种基于结构化潜在变量（SLAT）的预训练三维生成器，它将局部特征向量附加到稀疏三维网格的活跃体素上。 它通过修正流变换器分两个阶段生成资产：首先建立粗略的稀疏体素结构，然后在活跃体素上合成局部几何和外观潜在变量。 最后，应用不同的解码器将 SLAT 映射为高质量的多样化三维表示 [ 56 , 57 , 58 ]。

sents.zh: TRELLIS [ 3 ] 是一种基于结构化潜在变量（SLAT）的预训练三维生成器，它将局部特征向量附加到稀疏三维网格的活跃体素上。

paragraphs.en: SpaceControl [ 28 ] is a training-free method built on TRELLIS that enables conditioning asset generation on geometric inputs. Given a user-specified geometric control input 𝒮 \mathcal{S} (primitives or meshes), it encodes the geometry into the structure latent space via TRELLIS’s pretrained VAE encoder to obtain a clean latent 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1} . Instead of sampling from pure Gaussian noise, SpaceControl perturbs 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1} to an intermediate flow timestep τ \tau , producing a partially noisy latent 𝐳 τ \mathbf{z}_{\tau} , and starts denoising from this state. The timestep τ \tau serves as a global control parameter governing the trade-off between geometric adherence and generative freedom across the entire asset.
paragraphs.zh: SpaceControl [ 28 ] 是一种无需训练的方法，它基于 TRELLIS 构建，能够根据几何输入对资产生成进行条件约束。 给定用户指定的几何控制输入 𝒮 \mathcal{S}（基本几何体或网格），该方法通过 TRELLIS 的预训练 VAE 编码器将几何信息编码到结构潜在空间中，从而获得一个干净的潜在变量 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1}。 SpaceControl 不会从纯高斯噪声中采样，而是对 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1} 进行扰动，将其转换到中间流时间步 τ \tau，生成一个部分含噪的潜在变量 𝐳 τ \mathbf{z}_{\tau}，并从该状态开始去噪。 时间步 τ \tau 作为一个全局控制参数，用于在整个资产中平衡对几何结构的遵循程度与生成自由度之间的权衡。

As shown in Fig. 2 , our method takes as input a set of editable superquadric control shapes with per-primitive geometric conditioning strengths τ i \tau_{i} , alongside optional appearance cues a i a_{i} (text descriptors or reference images) for localized appearance control.

paragraphs.en: The primitives and their corresponding control levels τ i \tau_{i} first guide the Structure Flow Model (Sec. 3.4 ) during sparse-structure generation. Finally, self-similarity guidance [ 30 ] is applied to ensure coherent appearance and smooth cross-part transitions.

paragraphs.en: where τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} and τ high \tau_{\mathrm{high}} denote the endpoints of the flow interval over which spatial guidance is enforced.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} 和 τ high \tau_{\mathrm{high}} 表示空间引导所施加的流区间的端点。

paragraphs.en: First, we convert the complete set 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and the high-control subset 𝒮 high \mathcal{S}_{\text{high}} into meshes independently. Both meshes are encoded into the structure latent space via the TRELLIS VAE to obtain clean latents 𝐳 1 all \mathbf{z}_{1}^{\text{all}} and 𝐳 1 high \mathbf{z}_{1}^{\text{high}} . Additionally, we construct a binary spatial mask 𝐌 low \mathbf{M}_{\text{low}} by generating a bounding box around 𝒮 low \mathcal{S}_{\text{low}} and downsampling the region to match the dimensions of the latent grid. Following [ 28 ] , we perturb 𝐳 1 all \mathbf{z}_{1}^{\text{all}} with noise at timestep τ low \tau_{\text{low}} to obtain 𝐳 τ low all \mathbf{z}_{\tau_{\text{low}}}^{\text{all}} and begin the denoising process, thus establishing the coarse layout of the more flexible, low-control components.

paragraphs.en: Constructing Φ \Phi requires establishing semantic correspondences between the generated structure and initial primitives. Direct per-voxel geometric assignment is unreliable as low-control regions can be reshaped by the generative prior, causing drift from their original boundaries. To resolve this, we extract PartField [ 55 ] descriptors from the generated structure, cluster the active voxels via K K -means, and assign each semantic cluster as a unit to its closest input primitive. This produces a geometrically adaptive part-consistent routing volume, accommodating for structural reinterpretation. Details on cluster-to-primitive assignment and small-part handling are described in Supp.
paragraphs.zh: 构建 Φ \Phi 需要在生成的结构与初始原始元素之间建立语义对应关系。 直接对每个体素进行几何分配并不可靠，因为低控制区域可能会被生成先验重塑，导致其偏离原始边界。 为了解决这个问题，我们从生成的结构中提取 PartField [ 55 ] 描述符，通过 K K -均值算法对活跃体素进行聚类，并将每个语义簇作为一个单元分配给其最近的输入原始元素。 这样便生成一个几何上自适应且各部分一致的路线体积，能够适应结构的重新诠释。 关于簇到原始元素的分配以及小部分的处理细节，请参见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: We build on the optimization-guided rectified flow mechanism in [ 30 ] , extending its global appearance guidance with the routing volume Φ \Phi . Each cue a i a_{i} is encoded into an embedding 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i} . Within every cross-attention layer, each latent voxel attends only to the embedding selected by Φ \Phi . This confines each cue to its user-intended region.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 [ 30 ] 中提出的优化引导的修正流机制基础上进行改进，通过路由体积 Φ \Phi 扩展了其全局外观引导功能。 每个提示 a_i a_{i} 都被编码为一个嵌入向量 𝐞_i \mathbf{e}_{i}。 在每个交叉注意力层中，每个潜在体素仅关注由 Φ \Phi 选定的嵌入向量。 这将每个提示限制在其用户指定的区域内。

paragraphs.en: Cross-attention routing alone does not completely isolate local cues because subsequent self-attention can inadvertently propagate and blend appearance features across distinct parts [ 60 , 61 ] . We inject a soft self-attention bias modulated by Φ \Phi . For any query-key pair sharing the same assigned condition, we add a positive bias of log ⁡ β \log\beta ( β > 1 \beta>1 ) to their raw attention logit [ 62 ] . This prioritizes intra-part feature propagation without blocking interactions across the rest of the asset.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠交叉注意力路由无法完全隔离局部线索，因为后续的自注意力可能会无意中传播并融合不同区域的外观特征 [ 60 , 61 ] 。 我们通过 Φ \Phi 调制来注入一种软自注意力偏差。 对于任何共享相同分配条件的查询-键对，我们会在它们的原始注意力 logits 上添加一个 log ⁡ β \log\beta（β > 1 \beta>1）的正向偏差 [ 62 ] 。 这优先促进区域内部的特征传播，同时不会阻断资产其余部分之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our localized geometric control formulation ( τ high = 10 \tau_{\text{high}}\!=\!10 and τ low = 3 \tau_{\text{low}}\!=\!3 ) in direct comparison to SpaceControl with uniform global guidance scales ( τ = 3 \tau\!=\!3 or τ = 10 \tau\!=\!10 ). paragraphs.en: We evaluate the performance of SpaceFlow in local geometric control using GPT 5.6 Sol as an automated VLM judge. We assess prompt and geometric fidelity (PGF), which captures high-control shape adherence and low-control prompt completion, alongside realism and overall preference. Each comparison is evaluated in three passes with random ordering and aggregated by majority vote.

paragraphs.en: To complement the VLM evaluation, we quantify spatial fidelity, regional feature deviation, and semantic alignment using three metrics:

paragraphs.en: (a) Regional Chamfer Distance. We evaluate spatial fidelity to the input primitives by computing the Chamfer Distance (CD) separately on the designated high-control ( CD high \text{CD}_{\text{high}} ) and low-control ( CD low \text{CD}_{\text{low}} ) regions. Specifically, we partition mesh faces by mapping each face centroid to the nearest input primitive surface, inheriting its assigned control level. All meshes are normalized to a unit cube, and we report the symmetric mean-squared Chamfer distance ( × 10 3 \times 10^{3} ). To quantify the difference in control enforcement across regions, we compute the regional delta Δ ​ CD = CD low − CD high \Delta\text{CD}\!=\!\text{CD}_{\text{low}}-\text{CD}_{\text{high}} , where a higher positive value indicates that the model effectively differentiates control strengths, preserving specified geometry more strictly in high-control regions than in low-control ones.
paragraphs.zh: (a) 区域切角距离。 我们通过分别计算指定高控制区域（CD high \text{CD}_{\text{high}}）和低控制区域（CD low \text{CD}_{\text{low}}）的切角距离（CD），来评估与输入原始几何体在空间上的保真度。 具体而言，我们将每个面心映射到最近的输入原始几何体表面，从而继承其分配的控制级别，以此对网格面进行分区。 所有网格均被归一化为单位立方体，我们报告对称均方切角距离（× 10 3 \times 10^{3}）。 为了量化不同区域间控制执行程度的差异，我们计算区域差值 Δ CD = CD low − CD high \Delta\text{CD}\!=\!\text{CD}_{\text{low}}-\text{CD}_{\text{high}}，其中正值越大表示模型能有效区分控制强度，在高控制区域比低控制区域更严格地保留指定几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Text-conditioned appearance. We evaluate on 83 83 text-conditioned assets across three variants sharing an identical base structure: (i) TRELLIS , applying the appearance flow model on fixed geometry without guidance or routing; (ii) GuideFlow3D , employing self-similarity guidance without routing; and (iii) SpaceFlow (ours), adding part-wise condition routing to self-similarity guidance (Sec. 3.5 ).

paragraphs.en: We introduced SpaceFlow , an inference-time framework for localized geometry and appearance control in 3D asset generation. Editable geometric inputs define the controlled regions, each associated with a geometric control level and a text or image appearance cue. During structure generation, the control levels modulate spatial guidance, allowing constrained regions to follow the input geometry more closely while leaving others unconstrained, relying on the generative prior. During appearance synthesis, the framework matches the input regions to generated parts and routes each cue only to its corresponding part, supporting localized conditioning while limiting cross-part leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpaceFlow，一个用于 3D 资产生成中局部几何与外观控制的推理时框架。 可编辑的几何输入定义了受控区域，每个区域都与一个几何控制级别以及文本或图像外观提示相关联。 在结构生成过程中，控制级别会调节空间引导，使受约束区域能更紧密地遵循输入几何，而其他区域则保持不受约束，依赖生成先验知识。 在外观合成阶段，该框架将输入区域与生成的部分进行匹配，并将每个提示仅路由到其对应的部分，从而支持局部条件控制，同时限制跨部分的干扰。

paragraphs.en: Evaluations combining vision-language judge assessments, user studies, and regional metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow successfully overcomes the limitations of uniform global guidance, enabling localized geometric control. Furthermore, localized appearance routing consistently outperforms existing unrouted baselines in prompt faithfulness. Overall, SpaceFlow enables users to specify not only what to generate, but precisely where each spatial constraint and appearance cue should apply.
paragraphs.zh: 结合视觉-语言评判评估、用户研究和区域指标的综合评估表明，SpaceFlow 成功克服了统一全局引导的局限性，实现了局部几何控制。 此外，在提示保真度方面，局部外观路由始终优于现有的无路由基线方法。 总体而言，SpaceFlow 不仅让用户能够指定生成内容，还能精确指定每个空间约束和外观线索应应用的位置。

paragraphs.en: Latent Space Mask Generation. To spatially constrain the conditioning mechanism, we construct a discrete 3D binary mask from the input primitives. For low-control regions, a single bounding box is fitted around all low-control superquadrics with 7 % 7\% diagonal padding. This continuous representation is first voxelized at a high resolution of 64 3 64^{3} , then downsampled to the 16 3 16^{3} latent space resolution via 4 × 4 × 4 4\times 4\times 4 average pooling, and finally binarized with a threshold of > 0 >0 (marking any latent cell with non-zero occupancy). The resulting binary mask directly dictates where the latent flow blending is applied.

paragraphs.en: Each active voxel inherits the primitive assignment a ⁡ ( ℓ j ) a(\ell_{j}) of its cluster, so all voxels in the same semantic cluster are routed consistently. paragraphs.en: (i) meaningful control contrast , ensuring high-control regions specify well-defined structural elements while low-control regions remain intentionally coarse to test generative completion rather than trivial generation. (ii) spatial validity , confirming that low-control primitives are not geometrically contained by high-control ones. (iii) appearance fidelity , verifying that per-part appearance prompts are coherent, unambiguous, and accurately mapped to target primitives.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 有意义的控制对比，确保高控制区域明确指定结构清晰的结构元素，而低控制区域则有意保持粗略，以测试生成式补全而非简单的生成。 (ii) 空间有效性，确认低控制的基本元素在几何上不被高控制的基本元素所包含。 (iii) 外观保真度，验证各部分的外观提示是否连贯、无歧义，并能准确映射到目标基本元素。

paragraphs.en: To isolate geometric control from appearance quality, we render the generated assets as untextured shapes at the same scale and alignment as the input superquadrics. This prevents appearance quality from masking geometric defects.

paragraphs.en: Semantic-Geometric Conflicts. A primary failure mode in our geometric control module occurs when the text prompt contradicts the input geometry (e.g. , requesting a “standing person” over a “bench” structure). In such cases, the text-conditioning pathway attempts to generate human features while the geometric guidance enforces the shape of the high-control regions. Because the underlying generator lacks a joint prior for geometric and textual combinations, the model struggles to reconcile both signals. This typically results in unnatural geometric distortions as the model attempts to synthesize the text-described asset around the constrained high-control regions (see Fig. S10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 语义-几何冲突。 我们的几何控制模块中一种主要的失效模式发生在文本提示与输入几何结构相互矛盾时（例如，在“长凳”结构上要求生成一个“站立的人”）。 在这种情况下，文本条件通路试图生成人类特征，而几何引导则强制维持高控制区域的形状。 由于底层生成器缺乏对几何与文本组合的联合先验知识，模型难以协调这两种信号。 这通常会导致不自然的几何扭曲，因为模型试图在受约束的高控制区域周围合成文本所描述的资产（参见图 S10）。

paragraphs.en: Misrouted Appearance Cues. Our appearance module inherits the granularity of the underlying part decomposition: the routing volume is derived from PartField clusters in 32 3 32^{3} voxel space, and each cluster is assigned to a single appearance condition. When a cluster boundary does not coincide with the true material boundary of the generated asset, the corresponding appearance cue is applied to the wrong voxels, and the error is directly visible in the final texture. Fig. S11 shows two representative cases. In the frying pan, the routing volume assigns the pan body and the handle to different conditions, but a thin band of handle voxels leaks along the rim; the wooden handle appearance consequently bleeds onto the metal body. In the chair, the seat cluster does not fully cover the cushion surface, so only part of the seat receives the intended upholstery condition while the remaining voxels are textured by the competing condition, yielding a visibly discontinuous seat. Both failures are localized to the routing stage rather than the generator: the geometry is faithful to the input primitives, and only the region-to-condition assignment is incorrect. Finer part decompositions or soft, distance-weighted routing boundaries are a natural direction for mitigating this effect.
paragraphs.zh: 外观线索错误路由。我们的外观模块继承了底层部件分解的粒度：路由体积源自 32×3×32³ 体素空间中的 PartField 聚类，且每个聚类被分配给单一的外观条件。当聚类边界与生成资产的真实材料边界不重合时，相应的外观线索就会被错误地应用于错误的体素，这种错误在最终纹理中会直接显现。图 S11 展示了两个典型示例。在煎锅中，路由体积将锅身和手柄分配到了不同的外观条件，但一条细长的手柄体素带沿锅沿溢出；因此，木质手柄的外观特征便“渗透”到了金属锅身上。在椅子上，座椅聚类未能完全覆盖坐垫表面，导致只有部分座椅区域获得了预期的软包条件，而其余体素则由冲突的条件进行纹理化，从而形成了肉眼可见的不连续座椅。这两种失败都局限于路由阶段，而非生成器本身：几何结构忠实于输入的原语，仅区域到外观条件的分配出现了错误。采用更精细的部件分解或柔和的距离加权路由边界，是缓解这一问题的自然方向。
